summary: Map NGO stakeholders, plan community engagement and track feedback responses. Explore the five-day stakeholder engagement training course.
lede: Stakeholder mapping and engagement helps NGO programme teams identify whose input shapes decisions and plan appropriate follow-up. Participants practise building stakeholder registers, assessing influence and representation risks, choosing engagement methods, and assigning ownership for feedback responses. The course also covers access barriers, safeguarding considerations and practical engagement plans that connect stakeholder input with programme decisions.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits NGO staff who coordinate community relationships, programme delivery, partnerships, accountability or external reporting. It is designed for professionals who need to turn stakeholder information into engagement choices and traceable follow-up.
prerequisites: Prior experience in NGO programme delivery, partnerships, community engagement, accountability or monitoring and evaluation is recommended. No coding or programming is required; exercises use stakeholder information and spreadsheet-based tracking.
